title: Every Costume Was The Sleeping Bag
trend: TikTok + Instagram Reels Halloween 'Throwback Costume' (old photos of past costumes paired with a Halloween sound and on-screen text; New Engen 2026 Halloween TikTok & Reels list, peak the final week before Halloween). Zuri goes through Dad's throwback costume photos with the family photo album; Grandma Pearl reveals every costume for eleven years was the same green sleeping bag, including Zuri's baby frog costume and the tail of this year's dragon
youtube_title: Dad's old Halloween costumes were all the same sleeping bag 🎃
description:
Zuri goes through Dad's old Halloween photos. The astronaut, the dinosaur, the superhero… and Grandma Pearl has a confession about the sleeping bag.

#cartoon #animation #funny #halloween #shorts
tiktok_caption: dad's old halloween costumes were all the same sleeping bag 🎃 #cartoon #animation #funny #halloween

lines.text: Throwback costumes. Dad says his were the best on the whole block.
Not the block. The county.
Good evening. I am the family photo album. I have seen the county.
Okay, page one. Nineteen eighty eight.
The astronaut. Very scientific. Very brave.
Aluminum foil and a salad bowl.
My good salad bowl. I never saw it again.
It was a helmet, Mom. It went to space.
It went to the fire department. You got your head stuck.
Dad, there are firemen in this picture.
My crew.
Page two. Nineteen ninety one.
The dinosaur. Terrifying. Kids cried.
A green sleeping bag. With the zipper as teeth.
Why are you lying down in the photo?
Dinosaurs rest. It's very accurate.
He fell asleep on the porch at six fifteen. I handed out candy around him.
Three children asked if he was a cucumber.
A scary cucumber.
Page three. Nineteen ninety four. Dad, please.
The superhero. Captain Lamar. Fastest boy on Maple Street.
Grandma's tights, and a cape made from the shower curtain.
The shower curtain with the ducks.
They were eagles!
They were ducks, Lamar. They came with the bath mat.
Why is the cape wet?
He took a shower before trick or treating. Without removing the cape.
Superheroes stay clean.
So far, a salad bowl, a cucumber and a duck shower.
Different times. We had imagination.
We had one sleeping bag.
Wait. What do you mean, one sleeping bag?
Page four. Nineteen ninety five. The ghost.
A green sleeping bag. With eye holes.
Green ghost?
Very rare ghost.
Page five. The pumpkin. A green sleeping bag. Stuffed with leaves.
Page six. The race car. A green sleeping bag. On a skateboard.
Mom. Was every costume the sleeping bag?
Eleven years. One sleeping bag. I was a genius.
I told my whole office I was a pirate in ninety seven!
You were. The sleeping bag had a hat.
This is amazing. Okay, last page. Me, as a baby.
Page twelve. Two thousand nine. The little frog.
I was so cute. Mom says Grandma sewed it by hand.
A green sleeping bag. Cut very small.
Grandma!
It was a good sleeping bag. It deserved a career.
Okay, but this year I bought my own costume. With my own money.
The dragon in the closet?
Yes. Why do you say it like that?
I had to hem the tail. It was very long.
So I added a little something from the garage.
It is green. It zips.
Grandma, no!
Welcome to the county.
Next year, the sleeping bag goes as a sleeping bag.
I am saving page thirteen.
